# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 with updated HarfBuzz and GLES interop. It disables RAW and DNG decoding, updates HarfBuzz to 14.4.0, and incorporates current m155 renderer fixes.

## Breaking Changes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The bundled codec no longer decodes RAW or DNG images. Decode these formats with a dedicated library and provide a supported raster image to SkiaSharp instead. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m155** — The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 155 and includes the latest upstream bug-fix sync. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196))

## API Surface

- **Pointer-based GLES interop** — GLES interop signatures use pointer-based forms for direct native interoperation. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and its corresponding HarfBuzzSharp release. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz engine and HarfBuzzSharp release to version 14.4.0.

## Preview 2 (September 29, 2026)

Preview 2 added the HarfBuzz 14.4.0 update, pointer-based GLES interop, m155 bug fixes, and disabled RAW and DNG decoding.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14...v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13)
